title: Rescue result schema v3 (public receiver subset)
description: RR-001 ONB mirror of the canonical FLEET contract rescue/result-v3.schema.json. This is the PUBLIC RECEIVER SUBSET: the identity fields, repair/verification state, evidence references, remaining blocker, outcome digest and the receiver's own transport receipts. The canonical FLEET file is authoritative; this mirror is pinned by x-canonical (path + $id + version + sha256) so drift is detectable (tests/rescue/RR-001/test_result_v3_contract_mirror.py). A transport receipt (delivered) is a SEPARATE record from repair state (repair_status); one never implies the other, and a receipt alone never resolves an incident.

incident_id.description: Canonical incident id (RR-002: the admission ticket id echoed into the originating task journal; a resolution MUST carry it).

runtime_id.description: Authenticated runtime identity of the box that produced the result (RR-002: never free text).

operation_id.description: Unique per delivery attempt. A repeated operation_id is an idempotent receipt, never a second effect.

outcome_digest.description: sha256 hex of the canonical structured outcome (redacted reply, evidence refs, scope, cards, verifier, actor). Empty or prose is never a digest.

repair_status.description: What actually happened to the machine. advice_delivered means ONLY advice was delivered; it must never be folded into repaired.

verification_status.description: Independent symptom verification state. repaired REQUIRES verified.

outcome_type.description: Advice-only completion must name its outcome type (advice_delivered|answered|deferred|client_reported|...), so a reader can tell advice from a repair. Required when repair_status=advice_delivered (see allOf).

evidence_refs.description: Referenced evidence (symptom check, preflight, revert, execution receipt, verification receipt).

transport_receipt.description: RECEIVER-OWNED. Recorded separately from repair state (RR-001). A delivered transport receipt alone NEVER resolves: it is a delivery fact, not a repair claim. receipt_state is one of the receiver's terminal receipt states.

receipt_state.description: receipt_confirmed = the server returned a matching structured receipt for THIS operation+attempt. receipt_only_unverified = the transport delivered but no v3 repair proof was attached (legacy ACK: readable as delivered-only until upgraded).

reply.description: Redacted actual structured client reply (RR-001: the stored answer was the original instruction, not the client reply).

history_failure_reason.description: When the repair addresses a failure that historically rejected a real repair (defective historical wording), the repair is still valid on its own v3 evidence.

allOf.description: RR-001 gate restated in the mirror so a receiver-side validator cannot accept a promise as a repair.
Advice-only completion carries an explicit outcome type and never claims the machine was fixed.
